Metadata.title: Timbre — Clone Any Voice Locally
Metadata.description: Timbre is a fast, self-hosted voice cloning and text-to-speech engine. Upload a sample, write your script, and generate speech in your voice.

Hero.title: Give your text a voice.
Hero.subtitle: Upload a short sample, write a script, and generate natural speech in that voice — running on your own hardware, in seconds.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.body: Add a voice sample by uploading a file or recording from your microphone, write the script you want spoken, choose a model, and generate.

voiceSample.title: Voice sample
voiceSample.body: Samples must be MP3 or WAV, between 1 and 30 seconds long. Uploaded and recorded audio is automatically converted to 24kHz WAV before generation.

script.title: Script
script.body: Each model has its own length limit — the English model counts words, the bilingual model counts characters, since word-splitting doesn't apply cleanly to Chinese text.

models.title: Models
models.body: The English model is tuned for low-latency English-only generation. The bilingual model supports both English and Chinese in the same script.

limits.title: Limits
limits.body: Generation runs on a single request at a time per session and may take longer for the bilingual model, which also transcribes the voice sample as a reference before generating.

Footer.tagline: Self-hosted voice cloning, running on your own hardware.
